description: A document source: an official gazette, government repository, institutional archive, court system, registry, or other publisher of public-interest documents tracked by TransparencIA.

main.description: Registry entry for a document publisher or repository. One record per source, using a fixed slug as the record key. Referenced by tech.transparencia.document.item records via strongRef.

displayName.description: Human-readable name (e.g., 'Diario Oficial de la Federación', 'United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change').

sourceType.description: Kind of publishing source. Open set; consumers should tolerate unknown values.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the source's public website or repository.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, when the source is national in scope (e.g., 'MX', 'BR'). Omit for international or multinational sources.

jurisdiction.description: Legal or administrative scope this source publishes for.

language.description: Primary language used by this source (BCP-47, e.g., 'es-MX', 'en').

publisherName.description: Official publishing body name, if different from displayName (e.g., displayName 'DOF', publisherName 'Secretaría de Gobernación').

logoUrl.description: URL to the source's logo or seal.

description.description: Short description of the source, its mandate, and what kind of documents it publishes.

license.description: Default license, copyright status, or terms of use that apply to documents from this source (e.g., 'public-domain', 'public-sector', 'CC-BY-4.0').

identifier.description: Persistent identifier for the source (e.g., Wikidata QID, ROR ID, LEI, or canonical slug).

createdAt.description: When this source was registered in the AT Protocol network.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last materially updated.
